title: Hello Kitty Sanrio Wired Earbuds, 3.5mm Jack - Brand New
descriptionText:
Brad new. Unopened. 

Enjoy your music with these adorable Hello Kitty wired ear buds. With a 3.5mm aux jack, they are compatible with most devices and provide a high-quality sound experience. The earbuds are designed for comfort and come in a vibrant red color, making them a fashionable addition to your music collection.

The brand of these ear buds is Sanrio, and the model is unknown. They are perfect for anyone who loves Hello Kitty and wants to add a pop of color to their music player. These ear buds are ideal for portable audio and are perfect for use during travel or on the go. Get yours today and enjoy your music in style!
